title: Verify Nginx is listening on port 80
objective: Confirm the web server is accepting connections on the standard HTTP port.
rationale: Ensures the service is not only running but bound to the correct network interface and port.
expected_output: Output showing Nginx listening on 0.0.0.0:80 or specific IP:80.
success_criteria: The 'ss -tlnp' command lists port 80 associated with nginx.
